assertj-github-organization-2026-08-25.selection_rule: All public, non-fork repositories returned by the GitHub assertj organization repository directory at catalog construction time; archived repositories remain candidates. Repositories created after a case cutoff are retained in membership and resolved as not_created_by_cutoff.

membership_source.historical_query_fallback: If the service persistently rejects latest=false, the identical fixed slice is retried with latest=true and recorded per query.

ecosystems-maven-dependent-package-slice.selection_rule: Union of GitHub repositories named by historical dependent packages in the first 20 records of each fixed Ecosyste.ms slice (stars, dependent repositories, downloads, oldest creation, oldest latest release, and lexical name) for every evaluated source package in the maven ecosystem. latest=false includes historical dependents.

formal-openstack-global-requirements-202.selection_rule: All repositories in openstack/requirements projects.txt at the recorded revision, plus the coordination repository itself.

jcabi-github-organization-2026-08-25.selection_rule: All public, non-fork repositories returned by the GitHub jcabi organization repository directory at catalog construction time; archived repositories remain candidates. Repositories created after a case cutoff are retained in membership and resolved as not_created_by_cutoff.

maven-jackson-core-complete-dependents-2.selection_rule: All canonical GitHub repositories associated with every dependent-package row returned by exhaustive, name-ascending pagination for the source package; no E2 target label is read during membership construction.

maven-org-apache-derby-complete-dependen.selection_rule: All canonical GitHub repositories associated with every dependent-package row returned by exhaustive, name-ascending pagination for the source package; no E2 target label is read during membership construction.

maven-plexus-utils-complete-dependents-2.selection_rule: All canonical GitHub repositories associated with every dependent-package row returned by exhaustive, name-ascending pagination for the source package; no E2 target label is read during membership construction.

opendev-matrix-gerritbot-opendev-room-ex.selection_rule: At the source opening cutoff, find the unique Matrix Gerrit bot room whose projects list contains the source repository as an exact repository identifier, then include every exact repository identifier in that same room; wildcard entries are excluded uniformly because they are not concrete repository identifiers. The room and membership are selected without consulting E2 targets or relation labels.

opendev-wandertracks-organization-2026-0.selection_rule: All public non-fork repositories returned by the OpenDev wandertracks organization endpoint, without consulting any E2 relation or target label.

openstack-global-requirements-2026-08-11.selection_rule: All repositories listed by openstack/requirements projects.txt at 377f367109c44aaaefc73aa8776e314810e3ad37, plus openstack/requirements as the shared coordination repository.
